description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeCustomFieldAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods related to retrieving, updating, and validation of custom employee fields via the API, including permission checks and mock setups.
external_files: OrangeHRM\Entity" files, including CustomField and Employee classes

classes.name: EmployeeCustomFieldAPITest
classes.description: Test suite for EmployeeCustomFieldAPI which performs unit testing of its methods including get, update, validation, and permission checks.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee's custom fields, including mocks for services and validation of normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for 'getOne' method, including permission-based access control.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies updating employee custom fields, including permission checks and persistence.

methods.name: testUpdateWithoutPermission
methods.description: Ensures that users without proper update permissions are forbidden from modifying data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the rules for the update method, including handling of various input cases.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Confirms that delete operation is not implemented and raises the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that delete validation rules are not implemented and raise exceptions.
